purchase.title: Upgrade Loris Tunnel Pro
purchase.intro: Choose a license term. Buy in your browser, then return here to activate.
purchase.step1: Complete payment on the 16688 product page.
purchase.step2: Copy your license code from the 16688 order page.
purchase.step3: Return to the app, select Activate a code, and paste your code.
purchase.deviceHint: One code per device. The term starts at first successful activation; the server determines the expiry.

purchase.statusFailed: Could not check license status. Check your connection and retry. The previous status has been retained.
